questions.stem: A train dispatcher sees nominal wage up 8% and inflation 6%; real wage change is
questions.explanation: Real wage change equals 8% minus 6%, or 2%. The real wage is the nominal wage divided by the price level, so it measures purchasing power rather than a cash amount. Using the nominal wage as the real wage is the common slip.
